interpretation: The exact-CCN CMS record's self-reported Tribal ownership value is retained and is not overwritten by operator evidence. CMS's current locator identifies the exact Lawton hospital as IHS-affiliated, and IHS's current official facility page and federally-operated-facilities dashboard identify Lawton as an IHS-operated hospital. Because 25 USC 1603(12)(A) includes health programs administered directly by IHS and 45 CFR 180.30(b)(2) deems hospitals operated by an Indian Health Program in compliance with Part 180, these facility-specific sources support the Indian Health Program scope category. This is a scope classification only and makes no pointer-linkage, current MRF availability, file-quality, or rate-level claim.
